findings: Original prostate outline is coarse and does not supply zonal/capsular/neurovascular/ductal layers.
Suspicious source target is a separate ROI, not proven histological tumour extent.
Original T2 planes and source-derived masks show local source correspondence; no new fit or segmentation was generated.
Source US frame appearance and private voxel-size discrepancy remain explicit; no MRI-US native registration is supplied.
Original source T2 DICOM window metadata is used for review display; all stored samples remain unchanged.
